warm hospitality
Jun 2026 • Business
I would like to express my heartfelt thanks to Thuy, the Supervisor, and Hoan, the Manager, for their hospitality, kindness, and willingness to help.

From the moment I arrived at the restaurant, they made me feel welcome. They seated me at a table, explained the menu, showed me the different options, and recommended what would be best to try. They were always smiling, friendly, and attentive.

We had a lovely conversation together. Hoan gave me several recommendations on what to visit in the city, where it would be best to rent a car, and which shops were worth visiting.

I also had a very pleasant conversation with Thuy. He spoke a little Russian and shared his story of learning my native language. It was very touching and meant a lot to me.

Sometimes it is not the hotel itself that creates the impression, but the people who work there. Thuy and Hoan truly made my stay more special through their warmth and genuine hospitality.

Once again, thank you so much for your kindness and hospitality. When you meet people like this, it makes you want to come back to the hotel again.

5 out of 5 stars.
